explanation: Researchers first set up the camera in 1991 so they could check whether the pot was empty before walking to it. The picture went on the web in 1993.

claims.text: The Trojan Room coffee pot in the University of Cambridge Computer Laboratory became the subject of the first webcam on the World Wide Web, in 1993.
The first webcam on the web showed a coffee pot, not a fish tank, a cuckoo clock or a bird feeder.
The camera was set up in 1991 on the lab's local network, so researchers could see whether the coffee pot was empty.
The coffee pot images were put on the World Wide Web in 1993.
